Inspected App addition: TaskShapingHost mounts one request listener and mounts the composer only on explicit request. Developer diagnostics, event/usage/context observations and the retained App boundaries described here are unchanged. No new telemetry or developer capability claim.

Inspected App and dock delta plus the canonical useLaunchChat path. The new dialog uses a portal; new chats still use createChatSession/setActiveChat/showChatPageOrDock, promotion reuses the existing conversation, and acceptance calls canonical navigate. No direct region, layout, Board or pane-host mutation was added; this placement delta needs no prose change.

Reviewed the API reference addition for explicit proposal acceptance, including exact source authorization, description persistence and deduplication, and this guide's public-interface routing table. Existing API/SDK setup and authority boundaries still apply. Historical hosted/AWS capacity and cost examples were not requalified; no new hosted or deployment claim.

Reviewed added phone Turn into Task row and standard Dialog/Button use. The existing phone overflow owns dismissal; the shaping composer uses token-based styles, wrapping context controls and 44px input/select targets. Existing region, picker and chat-creation contracts are unchanged; real-device behavior remains separate from CSS-viewport screenshots.

Inspected App mount delta: TaskShapingHost is an explicit event listener and lazy-mounted conversation composer. No VAPID, subscription, permission, push audience, event delivery, service-worker or notification route owner changed. Existing push claims need no prose change; no push-delivery proof is inferred from shaping tests.

Inspected dock change: the added Task-promotion callback reads the active Session's project/agent/identity and uses existing chat operations. It adds no settings key, config persistence, directory override or engine-default mutation. Current config explanations remain accurate for this delta.

Reviewed TaskGraph create delta and this acceptance guide's seeded-dispatch fixture scope. Proposal acceptance only adds an explicitly accepted description and Session relation; it does not change dispatch, CRDT room history, presence, attribution or the browser acceptance control. No new room, cross-device or real-model acceptance claim.

Inspected createTask client pass-through, TaskCreateInput.shapingSource, route validation and atomic store behavior. Existing public SDK exports and required arguments are unchanged. The host-local useLaunchChat adds optional hidden model context while old callers retain their existing send call. New request semantics are documented in the owning API reference; this does not advertise a new published Builder or SDK experience.

Reviewed Task route addition and the unchanged kept-result/Basis branches. A spawned_session shaping link does not pin an answer or tool result and grants no read authority; explicit reference admission and publication remain with their existing owners. This delta needs no Basis prose or rendering qualification update.

Re-reviewed the new shaping steps against the now-clarified Starter Work guide: ordinary New Task accepts a chat proposal without dispatching implementation work, while the separate guided first-use title/launch path retains its existing operation and correlation contract. Direct chat still never silently creates a Task.

Inspected MessageBubble projection changes: only a normally completed, exactly identified proposal has its transport fence replaced by a card; all non-text parts, checkpoint controls, copy content and attribution remain. No workspace capture, filesystem restore or checkpoint authority changed; this delta needs no checkpoint prose change.

Reviewed documented host-context usage and chat example against the SDK client and host-local launch addition. Existing public chat hooks, provider context, authentication and required call shapes remain; proposal fields pass through the normal createTask transport and are covered by the SDK wire test. No standalone runtime or Builder integration is claimed.

Reviewed the dedicated Create a Task from a chat proposal section against TaskCreateInput, the source-turn route authorization, commit-time recheck, canonical brief and atomic Session link/deduplication.
